title: Governed harness refresh — re-admit PR #1429's mechanical corrections without model-routing policy regression

sha_binding.verified_source_note: Exact substantive branch head containing the complete seven-file port and both review-finding corrections. Commits after this anchor are restricted to this lane's own proof artifacts. evidence_commit_sha and current_pr_head_sha are resolved by CI; post-merge closeout rebinds the same gate-evaluated proof to the authoritative merge SHA.

pnpm_verify_static.detail: env:check, lint, type-check, build and the full unit suite completed clean on the lane branch.

unit_tests.detail: Aggregate across all test groups on the lane branch.

scope_conformance.detail: 7 files ported; 11 refused files verified untouched against origin/main.

model_control_preservation.detail: No model: line added or removed in .claude/commands/dispatch.md. All six references retained byte-for-byte at L175, L181, L231, L242, L308, L326. The model de-pinning change from PR #1429 is deliberately not ported; routing policy is owned by UTV2-1597.

review_finding_a_t2_merge_authority.detail: Corrected against .github/workflows/merge-gate.yml L512-543, which accepts three T2 approval artifacts: pm-verdict/v1 from CODEOWNERS (L521-527), a GitHub PR review approval (L516), and an executor-result/v1 self-attestation from AUTHORIZED_REVIEWERS (L528-535). PR #1429 documented two and wrongly asserted orchestrator self-approval satisfies the gate.

review_finding_b_env_export.detail: First-existing local.env -> .env selection with set -a export, executed across four cases. Case 1 local.env wins and the child process sees it; Case 2 falls back to .env; Case 3 reproduces the defect (bare source leaves the child seeing an empty value); Case 4 fails closed with exit 1.

hook_exit_semantics.detail: The ported bash-safety-guard.sh denied two real tool calls during this lane's own work, confirming the exit code blocks rather than warns. main's copy documents it as a non-blocking warning. Exit codes and matching logic are unchanged by this port; only comments and operator-facing messages differ.

runtime_proof_delegation.reason: static proof profile. This lane changes documentation and harness guidance only: no runtime code, no schema, no migration, no dependency change. Per scripts/ops/truth-check-lib.ts, the static profile explicitly does not require runtime queries (R1) or monitored-table row counts (R2).
runtime_proof_delegation.test_db_detail: ci:assert-staging refused locally: host=127.0.0.1 ref=unidentified, expected xskgrzbteyqdufktjrjx. Fail-closed guard behaving correctly; writable DB verification requires the staging-ci GitHub environment.

blast_radius.behavioural_change: None at execution time. The two hook files change comments and operator-facing message text only; their exit codes and pattern matching are byte-identical in behaviour.

out_of_scope_findings: .claude/hooks/tier-c-path-guard.sh header documents exit 2 as non-blocking while its own line 133 records the opposite.
bash-safety-guard.sh matches destructive patterns in quoted/documentation text, not only in executable position.
